subject: Re: Memento kickoff — go for the June diagnostic
body:
Team,

Decisions ahead of next week:

1) Go on the June diagnostic with Efe's recurrent-core workaround. The attribution caveat goes in the report verbatim — I'd rather ship an honest "interference is likely but confounded" than delay a quarter.
2) Our vulcan-h100 week starting 06-15 stands as planned — 256 accelerators, original + Memento retrains in parallel, report drafted by 06-19 and final by 06-24. Alina, please confirm the job specs are pre-staged by 06-12 so we use the reservation from hour one.
3) Scope cut: the second internal team's agent moves to Q3. One clean diagnostic beats two rushed ones, and the OKR lock on 06-26 only needs the first.

Carmen — the Breakout nuance is going straight into my portfolio review slide; it's the best "know what your bottleneck is" story I have.

Ulla
